title: Re-wire LTX to the new export: int8 balanced, bf16 high, media-derived routing
description: USER DECISION 2026-08-07: drop the distill LoRA toggle and the non-distilled dev model outright. HIGH stays bf16 distilled-1.1; BALANCED moves off fp8/mxfp8 to ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-1.1_transformer_only_int8_convrot (21.5GB), which A/B-beat fp8 on sound, hands and eyes and ran 10s faster. The re-exported graph (comfy_workflows/raw/ltx_i2v_t2v_template.json, 215 nodes against the shipped 119) changes far more than the weight: t2v and i2v merge into one file, Input_Video_Latent and Output_Preview put both stages in one graph (so the six LTX _stage2 twins die here, not in MPI-456), and routing derives from which frame slots are filled instead of op booleans. On disk today: fp8/mxfp8 deleted, int8 present, the 41GB bf16 never there - so NO LTX runs locally until this card ships, which is why MPI-465 cannot take its app proof first.
acceptance: variants.arch is DELETED and the _fp8/_mxfp8 workflow suffixes with it - int8 proven on the user Ada card; int8_convrot on Blackwell is inferred from other int8 models, so state that rather than claiming it
The six LTX _stage2 files are DELETED and stage 2 is reached in-file via capabilities.singleFileStages, H3 precedent from MPI-452

Routing is media-derived: the app writes no t2v/i2v/first-frame/last-frame boolean, and every Input_ title in the export is confirmed to LAND - injection silently skips a title matching no node, so a plausible WRONG video is the failure mode
The muted/bypassed nodes in the export are normalized by generate_ltx.py - the app prunes nothing, only the ComfyUI browser does
ltx23-transformer-fp8 and ltx23-transformer-mxfp8 are retired, and the int8 weight is uploaded to R2 with HF as mirrorUrl - LTX deps serve models.cubric.studio
An LTX generation completes THROUGH THE APP - which is also the last open item on MPI-465
